name: Ocal Browser v9.0.00 (Stable)
body:
OCAL BROWSER - STABLE RELEASE CATALOG
Version: 9.0.00 Stable
Release Date: September 9, 2026

===============================================================================
[SEAMLESS UI/UX REFINEMENT & LIQUID INTERACTIONS]
===============================================================================
* BENTO SHOWROOM UI: Completely refined browser UI/UX with zero-jump hover physics, unified glassmorphic bento showroom styling, responsive modal sheets, and fluid 60FPS transitions across all popups and sidebars.
* POPUP POLISHING: Removed redundant drop-shadow artifacts and cleaned up all dropdown modals (Site Settings, Site Info, Volume Booster, Shield Popup, Bookmark Manager) for ultra-clean shadowless aesthetics.
* STREAMLINED CHROME CONTROLS: Cleaned up window action bar and optimized toolbar density for immersive widescreen web browsing.

===============================================================================
[TURBO PAGE ENGINE & ACCELERATED AD BLOCKER]
===============================================================================
* ULTRA-FAST REQUEST INTERCEPTION: Re-architected request interception pipeline, zero-overhead regex filtering, and instant DOM pre-compilation for blistering page load speeds.
* AD BLOCKER ACCELERATION: Upgraded uBlock Origin engine integration for near-instant tracker neutralization and zero CPU stutters.

===============================================================================
[OVERHAULED BENTO FILE MANAGER]
===============================================================================
* REDESIGNED EXPLORER INTERFACE: Brand-new bento file explorer with instant file previewing, media grid view, category tagging, drag-and-drop actions, real-time storage analytics, and lightning search.

===============================================================================
[MASTERWORK AI INTELLIGENCE & IMAGE STUDIO]
===============================================================================
* AI IMAGE STUDIO: Upgraded FLUX, DALL-E 3 & LLM engines with smart master prompt auto-enhancement, camera lens optics, zero-flash background preloading, and 4K HD canvas sharpening.
* TWO-COLUMN AI SIDEBAR: Dual-panel conversational AI interface with real-time settings control, text-to-speech voice, and web summarizer integration.

===============================================================================
[DEEP HOME PAGE CUSTOMIZATION SUITE]
===============================================================================
* HOME CUSTOMIZATION: Personalize your home screen with custom bento card ordering, dynamic background wallpapers, animated particle density, clock widgets, and 25+ curated accent themes.

===============================================================================
[AMBIENT BACKGROUND SOUNDSCAPES & AUDIO PLAYER]
===============================================================================
* AMBIENT AUDIO ENGINE: Immersive background audio player featuring lo-fi beats, ambient chill-out tracks, rain sounds, and focus frequencies to keep you in the flow while browsing.

===============================================================================
[REAL-TIME PAGE EFFECTS & GPU SHADERS]
===============================================================================
* VISUAL ATMOSPHERE SHADERS: Dynamic visual atmosphere engine with CRT retro scanlines, liquid glass distortion, ambient light blooms, and particle matrix shaders for any webpage.

===============================================================================
[MILITARY-GRADE PASSWORD VAULT & SMART AUTOFILL]
===============================================================================
* PASSWORD MANAGER REWORK: Completely reworked password vault featuring AES-GCM-256 encryption, native Windows Hello biometrics, zero-knowledge storage, instant 1-click autofill, and breach auditing.

===============================================================================
[PACKAGING & INSTALLER]
===============================================================================
* Standalone x64 installer compiled with Inno Setup 6 (LZMA2/Ultra64 compression) and native file associations.
